s:
Which of the following is/are correctly matched in terms of equivalent rank in the three services of Indian Defence forces? Army Airforce Navy
1. Brigadier Air Commodore Commander
2. Major General Air Vice Marshal Vice Admiral
3. Major Squadron Leader Lieutenant Commander
4. Lieutenant Colonel Group Captain Captain
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
x: Only pair 3 is right: Major = Squadron Leader = Lieutenant Commander. Brigadier equals Air Commodore and Commodore (not Commander); Major General equals Air Vice Marshal and Rear Admiral (not Vice Admiral); Lieutenant Colonel equals Wing Commander and Commander (Group Captain and Captain match Colonel).

x:
Manele was removed by a no-confidence vote on 7 May 2026 — now Matthew Wale is Prime Minister of the Solomon Islands (elected 15 May 2026) (Praveen CA-360 May 2026 magazine p.70; nit.com.au 15-05-2026)
